profile_text.body:
Black Forest Labs is a research lab founded in 2024 and based in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany. On its own site the company describes itself as a frontier AI lab building visual intelligence, meaning models that understand, reason, and act in the world. It points visitors to its FLUX models, which it offers through an API.

The site also lists the terms that govern use of its technology: developer terms of service, FLUX API service terms, self-hosted terms of service, non-commercial license terms, and a responsible AI development policy. That is the extent of the material available here. No litigation, no tracked products, and no other corporate facts are recorded.
